title.zh: Lightning Labs CTO警告eMudhra CA泄露风险，建议用户更新相关客户端
title.en: Lightning Labs CTO警告eMudhra CA泄露风险，建议用户更新相关客户端

current_state.zh: Lightning Labs CTO Olaoluwa Osuntokun issued an urgent advisory that CVE-2026-111943, tied to a compromised certificate authority, affects lnd, btcd, tapd and litd, urging users to update binaries or rebuild with Go 1.27.3.
current_state.en: Lightning Labs CTO Olaoluwa Osuntokun issued an urgent advisory that CVE-2026-111943, tied to a compromised certificate authority, affects lnd, btcd, tapd and litd, urging users to update binaries or rebuild with Go 1.27.3.
